checked: Checked the official CSC-hosted RA 6713 text for the sworn SALN and financial-disclosure duty, family coverage, filing intervals, statutory filing offices, inspection, copying after ten working days, and ten-year public availability; the lesson's factual statements match.

Checked the official CSC-hosted implementing rules for divestment: the thirty-day resignation period, sixty-day divestment period, and already-serving clock reckoned from when the conflict arises match the lesson.

Example 1, solved before reading the solution: thirty days after a June 1 assumption gives a July 1 calendar deadline when the first day is excluded and the last included; the lesson only restates the interval.

Example 2, solved independently: for the supplied new-appointee conflict, resign from the private business position within thirty days from assumption and divest the relevant interest within sixty days from assumption.

Example 3, solved independently: copying is available after ten working days from filing; public availability lasts ten years after receipt, so a statement received eight years ago is still within that period.

illustrations.position_quote: RA 6713 assigns filing offices by category:
illustrations.description: A compact routing diagram mapping each official category to its statutory filing office, with separate branches for Congress, courts, national executives, regional or local officials, armed-forces ranks, and all other covered officials.
illustrations.why: The lesson asks students to recognize several easily confused category-to-office mappings; a visual routing map would make those distinctions easier to compare and remember.
